title: Specify trust governance and cross-jurisdiction trust frameworks
requirements:
- State what GDHCN participation provides (issuer trust, document integrity) and what it does not
- Define what 'appropriate' PKI must cover (delegation, key lifecycle, revocation)
- Apply the 3.4.5 reasoning to certificate, credential and identity trust services, or explain where trust governance is treated
- Express requirements on the interface between DPI-H and national trust services
- Classify GDHCN as an external/cross-border trust network distinct from domestic foundational trust
- Separate person, professional, organisational and endpoint identity in mutual recognition
